name: Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
nodalDept: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
briefDescription: The Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme comes under the purview of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) of the Government of India.
descriptionMd: The "Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme" is implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises under the National SC-ST Hub programme. It provides financial support to SC/ST Micro and Small Enterprises by reimbursing a major portion of bank loan processing fees charged by financial institutions. The scheme covers both fund-based and non-fund-based loans. It reduces the initial financial burden on entrepreneurs and improves their access to institutional credit. The initiative promotes inclusive growth and supports the development of SC/ST-owned businesses.
benefitsMd: - **Processing Fee Reimbursement:** Up to 80% of the processing fee or ₹1,00,000/- (excluding GST and taxes), whichever is lower.
eligibilityMd: - Applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe category. - He/she should represent/own any MSEs unit. - MSEs availing loans from any Scheduled Commercial Banks, Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs), and State Finance Corporations will be considered under the scheme.
applicationMd: **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the official portal of the [National SC-ST Hub](https://www.scsthub.in/nssh-schemes/). **Step 2:** The applicant must click on the "Scheme name" and then click on “Sign Up” and register using basic details such as name, email ID, and mobile number. **Step 3:** The applicant must create a password and complete the registration process. **Step 4:** The applicant must log in using the registered credentials. **Step 5:** The applicant must fill in the required details and submit the application online.
